propositions: When a ticket re-enters review with an unaddressed BLOCK verdict, a deterministic pre-check compares cited evidence anchors from the blocking findings against the current plan material to detect unchanged persisting criteria.

The pre-check matches cited anchors verbatim against current plan text; if all matched anchors are still present and the description component fingerprint is unchanged, a warning is logged naming the persisting findings and their criteria, but the review runs anyway (warn-only, no decline).

Findings with no verbatim-matchable anchors or paraphrased evidence never trigger the warning on their own; the warning fires only when at least one anchor matched the old text and all matched anchors remain untouched.

The precheck.cited_anchor_warning flag is recorded in the review sidecar metrics on every plan review (true or false) to enable offline measurement of warning hit rate and predictive value per ADR 0054.

The deterministic pre-check avoids the residual wasted-spend gap left by verdict_reuse, which requires entire material fingerprint and review code SHA to remain unchanged; cited-anchor pre-check warns when only the plan prose containing blocking findings is unchanged.
